summary: Designed v5-grounded benchmark. Anchor = [ingest] note 'Cross-session task IDs must be namespaced session/id' (note:note-mq75a80r): native ids are session-local; cross-session refs MUST be {session}/{id}. Spec bench/specs/v5-grounded.md: resolveDeps(sessions) flattens multi-session task lists into one map keyed {session}/{id}, resolving blockedBy (local ids, against the task's OWN session) + sharedDeps ({session,id}). Fixed test bench/sandbox/resolve-deps.test.js (16 cases) PRE-COMMITTED concept — currently UNTRACKED, MUST be committed to HEAD before bench (worktrees fork off HEAD). Trap: a global raw-id index cross-wires deps on cross-session id collision (verified: realistic naive fails 3 collision/missing cases, correct ref passes 16/16; solution discarded, not left in repo). bench-arm.js: added ACCEPTANCE['v5-grounded'] + new --consult=search mode (ON preamble mandates search_knowledge). HONEST READ: divergence MORE likely than v4 (anchor is precise+code-governing, not general), but TWO risks: (1) running daemon (pid 43047, ~9min up) predates /search — returns 'not found'; search_knowledge tool exists in source (lib/mcp-core.js) + sibling task .../26 is mid-build — daemon MUST be restarted on current source or ON arm retrieval fails; (2) spec rule 2 states the correct per-session resolution plainly, so a careful OFF agent solves it unaided -> could still null. Did NOT run arms, did NOT commit.
